hero.heading: More than a school —
hero.description: Since {founded}, Smiley School has been helping students of all ages discover the joy of English — and the confidence that comes with it.

story.heading: How it all began
story.p1: Smiley School was founded with a simple belief: every student deserves a teacher who genuinely cares about their progress. Our founder, herself a Cambridge-certified educator, wanted to create a place where academic rigour and personal warmth could coexist.
story.p2: What started as a small after-school programme has grown into a full Cambridge authorised preparation centre, serving children, teenagers, and adults at every level — from complete beginners to C1 Advanced candidates.
story.p3: Today we're proud of {studentsCertified}+ certified students and a {passRate}% pass rate — but what matters most is the personal approach that makes all the difference.
